description:
Join to apply for the MÉDICO (A) ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (INCLUSIVA PARA PESSOAS COM DEFICIÊNCIA) – BELO HORIZONTE/MG role at CASSI

Na CASSI somos movidos pelo propósito que é “Cuidar do participante em todas as fases da sua vida”, ainda que façamos parte de uma equipe de atividade meio ou fim, nosso propósito é único e sempre voltado ao participante da CASSI.

Por isso acreditamos que o (a) Médico (a) Endocrinologista não é somente um cargo, mas participa ativamente da construção de estratégias para uma CASSI cada dia melhor.

Precisamos de pessoas que estejam dispostas a aprender e multiplicar conhecimento, avaliar e trocar ideias sobre o processo com a ótica de que podemos estar em constantes mudanças e melhorias.

Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão! Todas as nossas vagas são abertas a pessoas de todos os perfis, incluindo pessoas com deficiência (PcD), pessoas negras, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+, 50+, entre outros grupos minorizados.

Caso você precise de algum recurso ou adaptação para participar do processo seletivo ou exercer suas atividades, por favor, informe no campo “Descrição das atividades”. Estamos comprometidos em oferecer um ambiente acessível e acolhedor para todos.

Responsabilidades
  • Realizar assistência médica respeitando as premissas do Código de Ética Médica.
  • Exercer atribuições conforme a política da CASSI.
  • Realizar consulta e atendimento médico por meio de anamnese, exame físico, solicitação e análise de exames complementares conforme estratégias, programas e diretrizes da CASSI.
  • Emitir diagnósticos e aplicar recursos de medicina terapêutica e preventiva aos participantes.
  • Efetuar e requisitar exames complementares de acordo com os protocolos estabelecidos e necessidade dos participantes.
  • Interpretar resultados de exames de imagem, biométricos, hematológicos, bioquímicos e outros, comparando-os com os padrões normais para emitir diagnóstico.
  • Indicar e prescrever medicamentos e terapias visando à prevenção e tratamento das doenças e à promoção da saúde.
  • Emitir atestados de saúde e aptidão física e mental, quando necessário.
  • Emitir atestado médico com finalidade de afastamento das atividades habituais dos participantes quando necessário.
  • Realizar registro dos pacientes examinados no prontuário eletrônico do participante (PEP) anotando anamnese, exame-físico, resultados de exames, hipótese diagnóstica, tratamento, orientações e evolução da doença.
  • Ser, quando indicado pela CASSI, o responsável técnico em sua área de atribuição perante órgãos diversos.
  • Realizar atendimento de urgência e emergência, sempre que necessário, no âmbito da CliniCASSI.
  • Realizar interconsulta com outros profissionais de saúde, sempre que necessário.
  • Participar de programas e atividades de educação em saúde, articulado com equipe da APS, com vistas à melhoria da saúde do participante.
  • Elaborar relatórios e laudos técnicos em sua área de especialidade, sempre que necessário.
  • Realizar a notificação compulsória de doenças, sempre que necessário.
  • Participar de discussão de casos clínicos, sempre que necessário.
  • Participar de campanhas educativas nos campos da saúde pública e da medicina preventiva.
  • Prestar informações do processo saúde-doença aos participantes e a seus familiares.
  • Realizar diagnóstico da comunidade Cassi e levantar indicadores de saúde para avaliação do impacto das ações em saúde implementadas.
  • Orientar e zelar pela preservação e guarda dos equipamentos, aparelhos e instrumentais utilizados em sua especialidade, observando a sua correta utilização.
  • Utilizar equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI) conforme preconizado pela ANVISA.
  • Orientar os colaboradores que o auxiliam na execução das tarefas típicas do cargo.
  • Participar na elaboração do planejamento do serviço, seguindo as diretrizes da CASSI.
Atribuições Curtas
  1. Realizar atendimento médico aos participantes na área de endocrinologia, seguindo protocolos e diretrizes da Cassi.
  2. Realizar suporte técnico (treinamento, interconsulta, discussão de caso) às equipes da APS na área de endocrinologia.
  3. Realizar matriciamento com a equipe de saúde da APS.
  4. Participar da elaboração de protocolos clínicos.
  5. Acolher, realizar diagnóstico e propor tratamento em sua área de especialidade aos participantes encaminhados pela equipe APS conforme plano de compartilhamento do cuidado na atenção primária.
  6. Realizar acompanhamento dos participantes com as principais doenças endócrinas (diabetes, obesidade, dislipidemia) e propor alternativas para melhoria da qualidade de vida.
  7. Realizar encaminhamento externo conforme oferta e tipo de serviço previamente pactuado com a APS seguindo linhas de cuidado e respeitando o rol de cobertura do plano.
  8. Referenciar primariamente os profissionais da APS para quaisquer novos problemas de saúde identificados.
Requisitos e qualificaçõesPré-requisitos
  • Ensino Superior completo em Medicina.
  • Registro no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM).
  • Residência médica em Endocrinologia ou Título de Especialista em Endocrinologia com Registro de Qualificação de Especialista (RQE) emitido pelo CRM.
  • Experiência na área de Endocrinologia.
Requisitos Desejáveis
  • Experiência em atendimento ambulatorial em endocrinologia.
  • Experiência como especialista de apoio na atenção primária/são saúde da família.
  • Experiência como médico referenciado.
  • Aptidão para trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Experiência com tutoria de profissionais de saúde, processos de educação permanente ou continuada e/ou com matriciamento de casos.
  • Atuação no pronto atendimento, seja como clínico ou especialista.
  • Atuação em serviço orientado pelo acesso avançado/classificação de risco.
  • Experiência na elaboração de protocolos e diretrizes assistenciais.
  • Qualificação para realização de suporte avançado de vida (ACLS).
  • Atendimento médico especializado em endocrinologia e metabologia com foco em adultos e idosos.
  • Conhecimento e experiência em transição hormonal.
Informações adicionais
  • Salário: R$11.396,86 (após o período de experiência)
  • Jornada de trabalho: segunda à sexta (20 horas semanais)
  • Vaga 100% presencial.
Benefícios
  • Cesta alimentação: R$ 498,48
  • Vale refeição/alimentação: R$ 875,82
  • Plano de saúde (opcional)
  • Previdência privada (opcional)
  • Licença maternidade de 6 meses
  • Licença paternidade 20 dias
  • Auxílio creche
Observação
  • Os benefícios podem variar de acordo com o modelo de contrato. As informações devem ser confirmadas durante a entrevista.
  • O candidato tem a responsabilidade legal pelas informações registradas na inscrição, podendo a CASSI exigir documentação que comprove os requisitos obrigatórios da vaga.

description:
Estágio no Jurídico - Corporativo / Compliance

Título: Estagiário Jurídico - Corporativo / Compliance

Local: São Paulo - Híbrido

Venha fazer parte do nosso time de estrelas!

Somos o Grupo HEINEKEN, lugar de gente que cultiva relações respeitosas com as nossas pessoas, sociedade e planeta. Levamos no coração o #OrgulhoHEINEKEN que reflete a paixão pela nossa história e pela qualidade indiscutível das nossas bebidas.

Nós valorizamos a diversidade e sabemos que um time formado por pessoas com perfis diversos nos torna tão fortes e únicos quanto nossas marcas. Queremos inspirar e fazer parte da transformação de um mundo melhor para todas as pessoas. Não só para algumas. Esse é o nosso melhor e mais importante brinde!

Aqui, nos desafiamos a ser melhores todos os dias, buscando inovação e agilidade, para levar nossa estrela em cada coração e em cada copo brasileiro. E claro, nos divertimos na mesma proporção celebrando todas as nossas conquistas.

E ai, se identificou? Se você tem coragem para abraçar novos desafios e está a fim de fazer a diferença, vamos juntos transformar o mercado de bebidas. Acesse nossas oportunidades!

Seu brilho transforma a nossa estrela!

Missão do cargo

Criamos um ambiente baseado no Respeito e Cuidado com todas as nossas pessoas para fomentarmos espaços de confiança. Esperamos que as nossas pessoas estagiárias abracem a aprendizagem e o desenvolvimento explorando oportunidades com Coragem e criatividade. E que entendam o impacto das suas ações, independente da área, na transformação do mercado de bebidas e para levar nossa estrela em cada coração e em cada copo brasileiro.

Área de atuação

Atuará no Jurídico ( Corporativo / Compliance )

Principais atividades
  • Suportar os advogados na orientação jurídica nas matérias relacionadas às áreas societária, contratos, imobiliária, ambiental, propriedade intelectual, regulatório, concorrencial e compliance, criando minutas de documentos, atuando em projetos sob supervisão, avaliando riscos e provendo soluções para atender as necessidades do negócio;
  • Suportar a negociação, análise, elaboração e revisão de contratos relacionados às parcerias estratégicas, com o intuito de observar aspectos legais e resguardar os direitos e obrigações da Companhia;
  • Suportar os advogados na elaboração de documentos societários como alterações de contratos sociais, reunião de sócios, dentre outros, bem como avaliar criticamente esses documentos e realizar pesquisas de mercado e propor melhorias.
  • Participar nas discussões dos assuntos imobiliários da Companhia, incluindo o controle e a regularização dos bens imóveis, bem como dos assuntos relacionados às oportunidades de negócio envolvendo tais bens e as eventuais vendas e compras. title: Creative Director
description:
Creative Director for Monks

Monks is looking to add another CD to its superband of creatives. In this role, you’ll provide our clients with creative decks, ideas and direction, bringing forth award‑winning products and campaigns for some of America’s leading technology brands. If you are the Don(na) Draper of the digital and social age, we’d love to pick your brain.

Role & Responsibilities
  • As a CD, life’s a pitch: you engage projects for a living and relay responsibilities to others once the ball is rolling in the right (creative) direction.
  • You’ll own the creative execution of clients, seeing them through from pitch to final delivery.
  • You’ll visit clients throughout the region, leading workshops and providing creative direction for any kind of project.
  • A strong focus on social content, script writing, and film production is a must.
  • You bring top‑notch production thinking to the table and provide creative consultation when it comes to the nitty‑gritty of cutting‑edge campaigns.
  • As a CD at MediaMonks, you’re part of the most awesome production agency on the planet, operating as ‘one office across 11 locations’ with an incredible in‑house team of 1200 Monks and counting.
Come Turn Concepts into Projects

MediaMonks is one of those (50) companies creative people would kill to work for. You’ll be part of a young, successful and crazy‑ambitious company that is determined to reach Mars before Musk. In addition to an unlimited supply of incredible coworkers, MediaMonks gets you a one‑of‑a‑kind company culture, amplified by all the awards. If you’re the one, we’d love to be the zero so we can make beautiful binary babies together.

Requirements
  • We’re looking to hire an all‑round concept developer with at least +4 years of CD‑level experience in advertising or production at the highest international level.
  • Make no mistake, this role requires you to put pen to paper and come up with buzzworthy ideas, and have the ability to present them in equally compelling decks.
  • You will take ownership for the entire campaign, providing strong leadership and direction throughout all stages of a project, including the management of a wider team of creatives, designers, and animators.
  • You know how to show leadership without a show of force, giving our in‑house teams a clear creative direction and ownership over their projects.
  • You can independently lead fast‑paced pitches but also love going the extra mile when painstakingly pushing running projects to perfection.
  • You’re a digital genius with an innate taste for the latest and greatest social platforms, digital technology, an instinct for snappy writing and a natural feel for visual design.
  • You’re confident leading different types of work spanning from digital and social campaigns to platforms and websites, hero films and TVCs, and installations.
  • For film‑based projects, it’s all about the story: you champion storytelling and are experienced working together with film directors on integrated projects.
  • In digital, the user experience is king, and so you should be a sovereign when it comes to shaping concepts that captivate and inspire.
  • With strong pitching and presentation skills, you can represent MediaMonks by showcasing our cases, capabilities and culture to clients.
  • As part of a global company operating as one team across time zones, you need to be able to successfully direct work at a distance.
  • You understand the process and politics of advertising inside out and know when to be pragmatic if that’s what it takes to keep things moving.
About Monks

Monks is the global, purely digital, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc. With a legacy of innovation and specialized expertise, Monks combines an extraordinary range of global marketing and technology services to accelerate business possibilities and redefine how brands and businesses interact with the world. Its integration of systems and workflows delivers unfettered content production, scaled experiences, enterprise‑grade technology and data science fueled by AI—managed by the industry’s best and most diverse digital talent—to help the world’s trailblazing companies outmaneuver and outpace their competition.

Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services. It has remained a constant presence on Adweek’s Fastest Growing lists (2019‑23), ranks among Cannes Lions’ Top 10 Creative Companies (2022‑23) and is the only partner to have been placed in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020‑24). In addition to being named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023), Monks has been recognized by Business Intelligence in its 2024 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Awards program in three categories: the Individual category, Organizational Winner in AI Strategic Planning and AI Product for its service Monks.Flow. Monks has also garnered the title of Webby Production Company of the Year (2021‑24), won a record number of FWAs and has earned a spot on Newsweek’s Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces 2023.

We are an equal‑opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Medical Science Liaison role at Sanofi . Location: Recife / Brasilia. Field-based work model.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and visionary scientific leader to serve as a MSL with expertise in Autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes. This role combines deep scientific expertise with strategic thinking to enhance the identification and management of people at risk of developing T1D, emphasizing the benefits of early detection and the use of new immunomodulators.

Scientific Leadership & KOL Engagement
  • Serve as trusted scientific partner to key external experts (including KOLs, endocrinologists, pediatricians, and other scientific stakeholders), establishing and maintaining robust, long-term peer relationships
  • Conduct high-touch scientific exchange with experts from Centers of Excellence and beyond to convey a compelling and highly scientific narrative on T1D disease stages, importance of screening and treatment
  • Engage with experts to share scientific data, answer product-specific questions, and support them in developing best practices (e.G., infusion protocols)
  • Link internal partners to external thought leaders for education and research collaboration
  • Disseminate innovative medical education materials and foster medical/scientific information exchange within the medical community
  • Tailor engagement to different stakeholder segments based on comprehensive stakeholder mapping and local go-to-market model
  • Work with cross-functional teams to leverage an omnichannel approach, orchestrating high-touch and personalized engagement across innovative channels (e.G., social media, peer-to-peer communities, online portals)
Early Detection Strategy
  • Collaborate with medical teams to develop and implement evidence-based screening and monitoring protocols
  • Provide scientific expertise in the development of risk-identification strategies
  • Support the adaptation of global screening and monitoring strategies to local contexts
  • Contribute to the scientific validation of new testing methodologies and channels
  • Engage with experts to promote best practices in screening and early intervention
  • Promote experience sharing among key external experts to reinforce consensus on screening and treatment protocols at local level
Strategic Implementation
  • Partner with cross-functional teams in agile settings with self-organized teams around main customer accounts to improve patient pathways and remove barriers
  • Provide scientific input on screening partnerships and initiatives
  • Gather and analyze field insights to inform medical strategy and screening programs
  • Support Market Access teams in evidence-based discussions with regional payers, drug formulary committees, and key account decision-makers on clinical value and health economics
  • Coordinate and direct requests for ISS, RCT, Managed Access Programs to appropriate teams
  • Keep up-to-date on medical and scientific developments in the Type 1 Diabetes field
Individual Contributors
  • Maintain knowledge of and comply with the principles of Ethics and Integrity, Sanofi policies, and codes of conduct that regulate the pharmaceutical market.
  • Comply with and promote Sanofi's Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policies, with the objective of preventing accidents, avoiding health risks, promoting employee well-being, and reducing environmental impacts resulting from work activities.
  • Support Sanofi's Diversity and Inclusion strategy and initiatives to ensure that all employees and partners are treated with respect and receive equal opportunities.
Qualifications

Experience

  • Minimum 3 years experience as MSL in Specialty / Rare disease / Type 1 Diabetes area
  • Experience in T1D or immunology highly preferred
  • Background in clinical research or academic setting
  • Experience with population health initiatives or screening programs is a plus

Soft Skills

  • Strategic thinking.
  • Business acumen.
  • Interpersonal relationship.
  • Transversal collaboration.
  • Learning agility.
  • Ability to build proper environment to enable Playing to Win culture to flourish.

Professional Competencies

  • Strong analytical capabilities for data interpretation and insights generation
  • Excellence in scientific communication and presentation
  • Strategic thinking and ability to translate science into actionable insights
  • Strong collaboration skills for cross-functional teamwork
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders
  • Project management capabilities

Technical Skills

  • Advanced understanding of T1D clinical science and current research
  • Expertise in interpreting and communicating complex scientific data
  • Knowledge of screening methodologies and monitoring protocols
  • Understanding of healthcare systems and population health approaches

Education

  • Advanced degree required (MD, PharmD, PhD) in relevant scientific or medical field
  • Additional training in public health or population health management preferred

Language

Advanced English required.

Benefits and Why Choose Us
  • Be part of a purpose-driven organization that pursues the miracles of science to improve people's lives worldwide
  • Access comprehensive benefits including health insurance, life insurance, and pension plans aligned with market best practices
  • Enjoy flexible work arrangements that support work-life integration and well-being
  • Benefit from continuous learning and development opportunities through Sanofi University and specialized training programs
  • Be part of building a new concept in autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes by bringing early detection and the use of new immunomodulators capable of changing the course of the disease.
  • Join Brazil’s largest and fastest-growing immunology franchise, playing a key role in the growth strategy and market leadership

description:
Latin America Finance Business Partner - Sales & Marketing and Field Operations Role Overview :

We are seeking a proactive, dynamic and hands‑on Finance Business Partner to support our Sales & Marketing and Field Operations teams across the Latin America region. This is a high‑impact role where you will play a critical part in driving business performance, offering strategic financial insights, and providing actionable recommendations to enable growth and operational efficiency. You will be the key finance partner for these teams, working closely with Latam senior leadership to track field and sales performance, and ensure that business goals are met within budget.

On a typical day you will :

Strategic Financial Partnering : Serve as a trusted partner to Sales & Marketing and Field Operations teams, working on the databases and providing financial insights that drive decision‑making and support business strategies.

Budgeting & Forecasting : Lead the budgeting and forecasting process for Sales & Marketing and Field Operations organizations. Develop and maintain rolling forecasts, track budget variances, and ensure financial targets are aligned with operational goals.

Business Performance Analysis : Analyze financial data and key performance metrics for both Sales & Marketing and Field Operations. Provide insights into revenue generation, profitability, and cost control, helping to optimize spending and improve financial outcomes.

Cost Management & Efficiency : Collaborate with operational leaders to identify areas for cost reduction, process improvements, and operational efficiencies within the sales and field operations domains.

Financial Reporting : Prepare regular financial reports and presentations for senior management, highlighting key trends, risks, and opportunities in the business. Present clear, actionable recommendations based on financial analysis.

KPIs and Metrics : Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor the success of sales and marketing campaigns and field operations. Ensure alignment with business objectives and provide actionable recommendations for improvement.

Cross‑functional Collaboration : Work closely with world headquarters in Finance, Sales & Marketing, and Field Operations, fostering collaboration and ensuring alignment between financial and operational goals.

Ad Hoc Financial Support : Provide ad‑hoc financial analysis and support as needed for special projects, strategic initiatives, and decision‑making processes.

What You Will Need to be Successful :

Educational Background : Bachelor's degree in business administration, Accounting, Economics or Engineering (MBA or professional finance qualification preferred).

Fluent English and Spanish. Strong interaction with Latin America countries and headquarters in the United States, through conference calls and in person meetings.

Experience : 5+ years of experience in managerial roles as finance business partnering, and / or financial planning & analysis, ideally with experience in Sales & Marketing and / or Operations environments.

Analytical Skills : Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data, draw insights, and make strategic recommendations.

Business Acumen : Understanding of sales, marketing, and field operations metrics and the ability to translate these into actionable financial strategies.

Communication Skills : Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial data in a clear and compelling way to non-financial stakeholders.

Advanced Excel skills (including financial modeling) and Hyperion Financial Management (HFM) Oracle Hyperion Financial Management.

Collaboration : Proven ability to work cross-functionally with various business units and senior leadership to influence decision-making.

Problem Solving : Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to identifying financial trends and issues.

title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
Medical Science Liaison

Location: São Paulo

At Sanofi, we are driven by one purpose – we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Our team, across 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible.

We are creating a new paradigm with a first-in-class therapy in Autoimmune Diabetes (Type 1 Diabetes). Our newest core asset, resulting from the acquisition of Prevention Bio, aims to delay the onset of stage 3 type 1 diabetes. For the first time, people at risk have fresh hope and more time for children to be children with less healthcare and more care‑free childhood. The delay gives families and healthcare professionals more time to prepare care plans for a later diagnosis.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and visionary scientific leader to serve as an MSL with expertise in T1D. This role combines deep scientific expertise with strategic thinking to enhance the identification and management of people at risk of developing T1D, emphasizing the benefits of early detection and the use of new immunomodulators.

As a MSL – Autoimmune T1D Specialist, you will be the trusted scientific partner for external experts and decision‑makers, while also contributing to the development and implementation of screening and monitoring strategies and engaging with experts in new therapies such as immunomodulators. This dual focus position will drive both scientific exchange and strategic initiatives to improve early identification and management of T1D.

Main ResponsibilitiesScientific Leadership & KOL Engagement
  • Serve as trusted scientific partner to key external experts (including KOLs, endocrinologists, pediatricians, and other scientific stakeholders), establishing and maintaining robust, long‑term peer relationships.
  • Conduct high‑touch scientific exchange with experts from Centers of Excellence and beyond to convey a compelling, highly scientific narrative on T1D disease stages, importance of screening and treatment.
  • Engage with experts to share scientific data, answer product‑specific questions, and support them in developing best practices (e.G., infusion protocols).
  • Link internal partners to external thought leaders for education and research collaboration.
  • Disseminate innovative medical education materials and foster medical/scientific information exchange within the medical community.
  • Tailor engagement to different stakeholder segments based on comprehensive stakeholder mapping and local go‑to‑market model;
    work with cross‑functional teams to leverage an omnichannel approach, orchestrating high‑touch and personalized engagement across innovative channels (e.G., social media, peer‑to‑peer communities, online portals).
Early Detection Strategy
  • Collaborate with medical teams to develop and implement evidence‑based screening and monitoring protocols.
  • Provide scientific expertise in the development of risk‑identification strategies.
  • Support the adaptation of global screening and monitoring strategies to local contexts.
  • Contribute to the scientific validation of new testing methodologies and channels.
  • Engage with experts to promote best practices in screening and early intervention.
  • Promote experience sharing among key external experts to reinforce consensus on screening and treatment protocols at local level.
Strategic Implementation
  • Partner with cross‑functional teams in agile settings with self‑organized teams around main customer accounts to improve patient pathways and remove barriers.
  • Provide scientific input on screening partnerships and initiatives.
  • Gather and analyze field insights to inform medical strategy and screening programs.
  • Support Market Access teams in evidence‑based discussions with regional payers, drug formulary committees, and key account decision‑makers on clinical value and health economics.
  • Coordinate and direct requests for ISS, RCT, Managed Access Programs to appropriate teams.
  • Keep up‑to‑date on medical and scientific developments in the Type 1 Diabetes field.
Individual Contributors
  • Maintain knowledge of and comply with the principles of Ethics and Integrity, Sanofi policies, and codes of conduct that regulate the pharmaceutical market.
  • Comply with and promote Sanofi's Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policies, with the objective of preventing accidents, avoiding health risks, promoting employee well‑being, and reducing environmental impacts resulting from work activities.
  • Support Sanofi's Diversity and Inclusion strategy and initiatives to ensure that all employees and partners are treated with respect and receive equal opportunities.
About YouExperience
  • Minimum 5 years experience as MSL in Specialty / Rare disease / Type 1 Diabetes area.
  • Experience in T1D or immunology highly preferred.
  • Background in clinical research or academic setting.
  • Experience with population health initiatives or screening programs is a plus.
Soft Skills
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Business acumen.
  • Interpersonal relationship.
  • Transversal collaboration.
  • Learning agility.
  • Ability to build proper environment to enable Playing to Win culture to flourish.
Professional Competencies
  • Strong analytical capabilities for data interpretation and insights generation.
  • Excellence in scientific communication and presentation.
  • Strategic thinking and ability to translate science into actionable insights.
  • Strong collaboration skills for cross‑functional teamwork.
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders.
  • Project management capabilities.
Technical Skills
  • Advanced understanding of T1D clinical science and current research.
  • Expertise in interpreting and communicating complex scientific data.
  • Knowledge of screening methodologies and monitoring protocols.
  • Understanding of healthcare systems and population health approaches.
Education
  • Advanced degree required (MD, PharmD, PhD) in relevant scientific or medical field.
  • Additional training in public health or population health management preferred.

Language: Advanced English required.

Why Choose Us
  • Be part of a purpose‑driven organization that pursues miracles of science to improve people’s lives worldwide.
  • Access comprehensive benefits including health insurance, life insurance, and pension plans aligned with market best practices.
  • Enjoy flexible work arrangements that support work‑life integration and well‑being.
  • Benefit from continuous learning and development opportunities through Sanofi University and specialized training programs.
  • Be part of building a new concept in autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes by bringing early detection and the use of new immunomodulators capable of changing the course of the disease.
  • Join Brazil’s largest and fastest‑growing immunology franchise, playing a key role in the growth strategy and market leadership.
Pursue Progress. Discover Extraordinary.

O FAS Advogados é um escritório brasileiro full service, que atua em cooperação com o CMS – um dos maiores escritórios de advocacia do mundo.

Cooperação com o CMS

Em 2023, estabelecemos uma cooperação com o CMS, presente em 49 países, com mais de 6.300 advogados em 82 cidades. Essa colaboração fortalece nossa capacidade de entregar soluções jurídicas de alto nível, com perspectiva global e sensibilidade local.

Nossa equipe está pronta para atuar no contencioso administrativo ou judicial, com a análise de todos os impactos de cada disputa para o seu negócio (riscos e benefícios), propondo soluções e com a identificação prévia dos melhores caminhos para defesa dos interesses da empresa.

Assessoramos nossos clientes desde procedimentos de fiscalização até a defesa de seus interesses nas instâncias mais elevadas dos tribunais administrativos.

Na esfera judicial, defendemos nossos clientes em qualquer local do país, inclusive nos Tribunais Superiores.

title: Head Of Growth Marketing
description:
Our Mission is to be able to say - “Anyone in the World below $15M should fire their Agency tomorrow as nobody can beat this Value & Service at this Price”

We’re looking for a Highly Motivated & Hard-Working Head of Growth Marketing to join the team.

As a Head of Growth Marketing, you will be at the heart of crafting data-driven forecasts and executing strategies that push our clients toward their goals. Your actions and initiatives consistently resonate with the core values of CTC Global, serving as a beacon for these principles. At CTC, your trained expertise is invaluable, covering the entire spectrum of CTC’s Strategic Forecasting methods and the foundational principles of media acquisition.

Your role extends past strategy alone, it’s also about fostering strong client relationships by clearly communicating the steps taken and how results compare to projections. This ongoing transparency builds trust and strengthens the connection between CTC and its clients, helping them navigate the nuances of media buying and long-term growth planning.

You stand as a representative and dedicated advocate for CTC's distinctive approach to media acquisition and its accompanying tools. As a Head of Growth Marketing, you are held to a high standard. People know that if you are involved, things will get accomplished.

You thrive on challenges, are committed to delivering measurable results, and take great pride in giving it your all. We embrace the mantra, 'Everyday in Everyplay, Count on Me,' meaning that you can see things through to the end!

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible Company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business.

To give ourselves our best shot at accomplishing Our mission, we organize all of our decisions—from recruiting, to hiring, to raises, to promotions, to how we spend our time and money—in the direction of three committed values.

We recognize these values aren't for everyone.

They're challenging. In fact, they're so challenging, that's why we invest so much in supporting our team and why we tend to attract people who are craving the opportunity to do more at work than get a paycheck. We're looking for those who are interested in making their work significant.

AUTODIDACT

  • Naturally curious and an autodidact, able to absorb information quickly and effectively, like osmosis. Your commitment to learning sets you apart, absorbing information swiftly and more effectively than your peers.
  • Your openness to both offer and embrace feedback as an opportunity for growth and implement it proactively, without needing constant direction.
  • Demonstrates resourcefulness, and independently refine your skills without being prompted.
  • Thrives in a self-managed environment, showing autonomy, initiative, and a commitment to continuous improvement and not requiring task lists built by their managers and constant oversight.

UNIMPEACHABLE CHARACTER

  • Embodies a character that inspires pride in both personal and professional associations.
  • Consistently honest, with the courage to acknowledge and communicate hard truths, and the humility to accept them, even when uncomfortable, and never lie in any situation.
  • Displays a high level of self-awareness, taking full ownership of outcomes without resorting to a victim mindset.
  • Values constructive feedback and integrates it, understanding nothing great is built without feedback.

COMPETITIVE GREATNESS

  • Performs at their best when it matters most, The Enjoyment of Hard Challenges.
  • Demonstrates an unyielding determination to get things done, regardless of obstacles, time constraints, skills needed, or resources.
  • Adapts to changing circumstances, recognizing that true success is about not just meeting, but exceeding what is required.
  • Possesses a deep passion for their work, using creativity and resilience to overcome any hurdle.
What Success Looks Like NECESSARY SKILLS

KICK OFF PERIOD

  • Be willing to put in the hard work required and be hungry enough to go through the kick off.
  • Being ready and prepared for this to be the hardest job you have ever worked, as you would fundamentally develop a high-leverage new skill.
  • The ability to take feedback and implement it fast.
  • Finish the work to the fullest with quality and on time.
  • Perseverance.
  • Remember and learn from the repetitive doing of the exercises.

ONBOARDING

  • Align with the team and contribute to the team called Brain Trust for Ideas across clients.
  • Manage, align & work with the team members of your pod including Google strategist, Creative Strategist, and Email Strategist.
  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple tasks with great attention to detail.
  • Upkeep of data integrity of your clients across Statlas.
  • Be responsible for the execution of the Prophet system for your clients
  • Building a Growth Forecast for your clients
    • Building a Growth map using the Prophet System
    • Data Analysis required for the Map
    • Marketing calendar alignment and upkeep with clients
  • The Daily Execution and Actualisation vs the Forecast.
    • You make tactical deconstructions and actualize the projections each day to adjust them to meet KPIs
  • Combine data analysis and feedback from clients to develop strategic plans for the future.
  • When it’s time to pivot you are among the first early adopters
  • Take a lead in situations that present any obstacle to execution.
  • An insatiable curiosity, and an inability to leave a problem alone until you’ve found one or many different potential solutions.
  • Responsible for the implementation of CTC’s Meta best practices
  • Build campaigns using our structure and best practices
  • Upkeep and management of our ideologies and processes throughout the account.
  • Monitoring active campaigns, and adjusting budgets and strategy to ensure the best possible chance of hitting the Daily Projected Targets
  • Implementing tests in your accounts in an effort to beat your best-performing campaigns.

ENSURING AND HOLDING THE STANDARD OF QUALITY OF WORK

  • Ensuring you are within a 5% Delta to the Forecast
  • Ensuring daily alignment with the client vs the forecast & strategy
  • Ensuring following the Prophet system execution to 100% within the timeline required.
  • Ensuring all the work is delivered based on the timeline assigned with optimal quality & attention to detail.

Client Communication

  • You are a champion of communication, ensuring the client is aligned on the Growth Map goals and next steps, while making sure everybody on your team has clarity on what is required with exact deadlines.
  • Responsible for sending daily performance updates to the client
  • Ensure alignment across Strategy and Forecast with the client for every day of the week.
  • Providing weekly updates on the Weekly Strategy Call.

CONTRIBUTING BACK

  • Contributing your learnings back to the system for feedback and continuous improvement
  • Contributing & collaborating in ideas and learning across teams
  • Contributing to ideas and learning in future company content production.
NEXT-LEVEL SKILLS

Communication Skills

  • Fluent in English, with a proven ability to communicate persuasively and present ideas clearly to various stakeholders.
  • Skilled in crafting thoughtful, empathetic client messaging that resonates, demonstrating a high level of emotional intelligence.
  • Strong presentation skills, capable of delivering compelling presentations that drive engagement and decision-making.
  • Strong raw talent for data analysis, with an eagerness to learn and improve.
  • Familiarity with data tools, including Google Sheets, with the flexibility to develop advanced skills through on-the-job experience.

Past Experience

  • Historical expertise that compounds to bring a well-rounded perspective and adds value to the role.
  • A breadth of experience from any of the multiple domains, including mathematics, data analytics, business operations, retail, finance, media buying, etc

Critical Thinking

  • Ability to approach challenges with structured thinking, utilizing logical frameworks to effectively solve complex problems.
  • Naturally adept at dissecting issues and proposing practical, impactful solutions.

Impact

  • Passionate about e-commerce and eager to contribute to a high-performing team at the forefront of the industry.
  • Highly motivated and hardworking, with a strong desire to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact.
  • Thrives in environments where they can see the direct results of their actions on the business, with a strong preference for roles that offer full accountability and autonomy.
Results

You will merge the Finance and Marketing sides of a business to build a forecasted strategy to help the business achieve its goal.

  • Achieve certification and confidence in our ideology by the end of the kick off, enabling precise execution of the Prophet system to ensure top-quality results for clients.
  • Consistently deliver high-accuracy performance within a 5% delta across the Prophet system’s Growth Map and Statlas.
  • Lead and collaborate with your team to optimize productivity and maintain high-performance standards.
  • Apply best practices in media buying to drive outstanding results, ensuring no one could achieve better outcomes in your role.
  • Maintain client satisfaction levels above benchmark rates, aligning daily on forecasts to exceed client expectations.
  • Adhere to rigorous quality standards in client feedback, forecasting, media buying decisions, and system execution.
  • Meet all deadlines and budget requirements, ensuring timely and on Target Performance.
  • Contribute valuable ideas to team discussions and company-wide content, supporting growth and innovation.

DOMAIN

MANAGEMENT

  • Your supervisor would be Joy Sharma, The Director of the CTC Accelerator Program.
  • You’ll report directly to Joy Sharma —a leader known for his relentless pursuit of excellence and an unmatched passion for growth strategy. Joy is a rare mentor, often described as the closest you’ll come to learning directly from Taylor Holiday himself. With a career built on his own rigorous, self-driven learning, Joy has transformed numerous team members into top-tier strategists, instilling in them the values of dedication, precision, and continuous improvement.

Working under Joy's guidance will push you to your limits in the best possible way. He models the value of hard work, and learning from him feels like “drinking from a firehose”—you’ll absorb knowledge quickly and consistently, experiencing tremendous growth. Joy is committed to personally ensuring you reach your full potential as a Head of Growth Marketing, supporting your journey every step of the way.

ORIENTATION

  • This role will be client-facing.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR ME?

SALARY RANGE

  • First month: $2,000
  • Second month: $4,000
  • Third month (on average): $7,000 a month
  • 1st Year Annual Range: $64,000-$76,000
  • 2nd Year Annual Range: $100,000-$120,000

This will depend on the amount of clients and the quality of work.

Growth, Transparency, and Fairness in Career Development

  • Progress is Clearly Defined
  • Depends primarily on your experience with the system & quality of execution against it. Following a well-defined path for the first 12 months and how exactly you can grow to be promoted to the next level.
  • Fairness and transparency are prioritized
  • Access a weekly performance dashboard to see exactly where you stand compared to team members on both objective and subjective metrics.
  • Pay transparency is upheld for all team members
  • With consistent contract terms and a clear roadmap for increasing earnings, ensuring everyone understands the path to greater compensation. We will also talk monthly about how you can progress.
  • My Commitment to You:
  • You will work harder, learn more than ever before, and “make more than you ever have.” You will gain a diverse skill set while actively contributing to the continuous development of new tools and improvements within our system. In doing so you will have an incredible opportunity for rapid career progression.
  • We will continue to provide you mentorship through every step of your development in the role and promotion from it. We will then continue to provide feedback against the expectation and evaluate against it.
  • Fully remote with the ability to pick your schedule.
  • Embrace autonomy as a core value, with clear expectations, regular 1:1 feedback sessions, and measurable quality benchmarks to support personal growth. Exceptional work is recognized and rewarded, with weekly check-ins for accountability, ensuring you’re consistently challenged and engaged with new opportunities daily.

title: Head Of Marketing São Paulo
description:
We're looking for a talented and passionate Head of Creative Marketing to join Wildlife's Marketing Team in São Paulo and lead our efforts in Creative Marketing, Influencers and IP Licensing.

As part of the Marketing Leadership, you will play a pivotal role in scaling our ever-growing portfolio of games. By leveraging your analytical skills, creativity, and in‑depth market knowledge, you will be in charge of experimenting with new AI technologies and acquisition channels that will shape the future of our Marketing operation.

We know that the work we do has a high impact on our company's success and culture. The right person for this position is curious by nature, comfortable in a "take the initiative" environment, loves solving problems, and can thrive in a fast and growing business.

What you’ll do
  • Creative Marketing: You lead our in‑house agency, in charge of the ideation and production of the ads running in our marketing campaigns. You will also manage external agencies that complement our internal production.
  • Influencers: You will lead and scale our influencer marketing efforts, tailored to the target audiences, leveraging their reach and engagement with a result‑oriented mindset to deliver our business goals.
  • IP Licensing: Cultivate and maintain relationships with partners from different natures (Sports Federations, global studios among others), negotiating contracts, making internal ROI projections and delivering best‑in‑class go‑to‑markets, together with the product teams.
  • Campaign Analytics: Utilize data analytics tools to track and analyze the performance of campaigns, measuring key metrics such as investment, and media / business metrics.
  • Trend Monitoring: Stay ahead of industry trends, competitor strategies, and emerging platforms or features within performance marketing, social media and influencer marketing landscapes, adapting strategies accordingly to maintain competitiveness and innovation.
What you’ll need
  • Strong team management skills as you will lead a 30+ organizational structure.
  • Deep understanding of the mobile marketing landscape, how different players operate and what are the main challenges and opportunities.
  • Autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result as well as promoting changes in the organization depending on the current situation.
  • Outstanding analytical skills to understand performance and make data‑driven decisions.
  • Familiarity and affinity with the gaming industry.
  • Creative mindset with the ability to think outside the box.
  • Strong commitment.
  • A strong bias toward action.
  • A strong learning mindset always seeking opportunities to improve.
  • Advanced English proficiency is mandatory.
About Wildlife

Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Here, we create games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come!

A Infosys Brasil está buscando profissionais com o perfil de Consultor Líder de PI para integrar nossa equipe.

Instalação e configuração do PI Server, AF Server e outros produtos do pacote OSI PI Suite.

Instalação e configuração de diferentes tipos de interfaces (PI OPC DA, OPC HDA, PI para PI, PI UFL e PI RDBMS) conforme necessidades.

Configuração do Coletivo PI e do Coletivo AF.

Compreender os requisitos do negócio e definir a solução.

Criação de modelos e elementos AF.

Criação / modificação de tags PI, tags Totalizer e equações de desempenho.

Configuração do PI AF Analytics, PI Notifications e PI Event Frames.

Criação de telas PI (PI Vision / Coresight / Process Book) e relatórios PI Datalink.

Um bom conhecimento de tecnologias de desenvolvimento PI, como OLED Enterprise, ODBC e RTQP.

Bom entendimento do processo ITIL.

Solução de problemas relacionados ao PI Server, PI Interfaces, AF Server e ferramentas PI Client.

Interagir e comunicar com a equipe no local para obter suporte e transição de atividades entre diferentes horários realizados.

8 a 14 anos de experiência relevante no sistema Aveva PI.

Formação superior em TI / Ciência da Computação / área relacionada.

Habilidades de especialização : PI AF, EventFrames, DataLink, PI Vision, Gerador de EventFrames.

Habilidades desejáveis : Experiência com o sistema PI nos setores farmacêutico, de mineração, de energia, de alimentos e agroindustrial.

Informações adicionais

Tipo de trabalho : CLT (Trabalho em Tempo Integral), Horário flexível.

Pacote de benefícios : Vale-transporte, vale-refeição, auxílio-creche, seguro de vida, auxílio-funeral, seguro médico e odontológico.

Carreira : Trabalho global em clientes e / ou projetos nacionais e internacionais, com possibilidade de transferência internacional de carreira.

Sobre nós

A Infosys é líder global em serviços digitais e consultoria de última geração.

Capacitamos clientes em mais de 50 países a navegar em sua transformação digital.

Com mais de quatro décadas de experiência na gestão de sistemas e operações de empresas globais, guiamos nossos clientes com maestria em sua jornada digital.

Fazemos isso capacitando a empresa com um núcleo baseado em IA que ajuda a priorizar a execução da mudança.

Também impulsionamos os negócios com agilidade digital em escala para oferecer níveis sem precedentes de desempenho e satisfação do cliente.

Nossa agenda de aprendizado contínuo promove a melhoria constante por meio da construção e transferência de habilidades, conhecimentos e ideias digitais de nosso ecossistema de inovação.

A Infosys oferece igualdade de oportunidades de emprego a candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, cor, sexo, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, práticas e observâncias religiosas, nacionalidade, gravidez, parto ou condições médicas relacionadas, condição de envelhecimento protegido, participação / familiar de um veterano protegido ou deficiência.

description:
Join to apply for the Accenture Strategy & Consulting - Senior Manager / Associate Director role at Accenture Brasil

Um time que faz parte da mudança Abraçamos o poder da mudança para criar valor e sucesso compartilhado para nossos clientes, funcionários, acionistas, parceiros e comunidades. Contamos com a maior rede mundial de centros de tecnologia avançada e operações inteligentes. Provocamos a mudança no mercado Trabalhamos juntos mundo afora para fazer um mundo de diferenças. A Accenture é uma empresa global de serviços profissionais líder em soluções para digital, nuvem e segurança. Ao combinar experiência incomparável e habilidades especializadas em mais de 40 setores, oferecemos serviços em Estratégia e Consultoria, Tecnologia, Operações e a Accenture Song. Ao trabalharmos juntos, a mudança se torna a fonte de progresso mais dinâmica e poderosa que você tem. Somos mais de 710 mil pessoas, presentes em mais de 120 países, engajados em fazer inovação todos os dias e transformar o mundo em um lugar melhor para as pessoas. As Melhores Pessoas Nosso principal valor é o Respeito pelo Indivíduo. O nosso maior ativo são as pessoas, não fazemos distinção de gênero, cor, orientação sexual, posição social ou deficiências. Todos têm oportunidades iguais de construir sua carreira em uma empresa inclusiva e diversificada. Junte-se a nós Accenture Strategy&Consulting reúne visionários estratégicos, profissionais de todas as funções da empresa, de inteligência de negócios, especialistas em mudança, autoridades de dados e IA e muitas outras habilidades especializadas para cocriar o caminho exclusivo de cada cliente para a reinvenção. Você será um parceiro confiável para os líderes de negócios, trabalhando com uma equipe diversificada de especialistas para oferecer uma transformação tecnológica bem-sucedida e novos tipos de valor para nossos clientes. A Accenture Strategy & Consulting apoia clientes na transformação de negócios, pessoas, processos e tecnologia, conectando visão estratégica, desenho operacional e execução orientada por dados e inovação. Profissionais em Senior Manager e Associate Director lideram projetos complexos, estruturam soluções de alto impacto e apoiam o crescimento de contas e equipes.

  • Liderar programas de transformação de negócio, impulsionando eficiência, crescimento e inovação em clientes de grande porte.

  • Conectar estratégia, processos e tecnologia, atuando com equipes multidisciplinares de Industry, Functional e Data & AI.

  • Liderar equipes internas e times integrados Accenture–cliente, promovendo cultura colaborativa e desenvolvimento de talentos.

  • Experiência em liderança de times e contato com alta gestão
  • Participação prévia em programas de tecnologia, processos, M&A ou modernização
  • Conhecimento em setores como Financeiro, Telecom, Varejo, Produtos, Indústria, Energia, Saúde, Público etc.
Formação e requisites

    MBA ou pós-graduação é um diferencial

Buscamos líderes estratégicos capazes de transformar organizações por meio de tecnologia, dados, inovação e desenho organizacional. É um papel de liderança com impacto direto em grandes clientes, conduzindo decisões críticas, influenciando C-levels e formando times de alta performance.

Já pensou em fazer parte da principal securitizadora do agronegócio no Brasil? O Grupo Ecoagro desenvolve e estrutura operações financeiras adequadas tanto às necessidades de rentabilidade e segurança de investidores quanto à demanda de recursos para produtores e empresas rurais.

Desde 2009 a Ecoagro está à frente no mercado como maior securitizadora em emissão de CRA no Brasil. São mais de 75 bilhões de emissões de CRA e 6.5 bilhões de fundos sob gestão.

description:
Na CASSI somos movidos pelo propósito que é o de “Cuidar do participante em todas as fases da sua vida”, ainda que façamos parte de uma equipe de atividade meio ou fim, nosso propósito é único e sempre voltado ao participante da CASSI.

Por isso acreditamos que o (a) Médico (a) Endocrinologista não é somente um cargo, mas participa ativamente da construção de estratégias para uma CASSI cada dia melhor.

Precisamos de pessoas que estejam dispostas a aprender e multiplicar conhecimento, avaliar e trocar ideias sobre o processo com a ótica de que podemos estar em constantes mudanças e melhorias.

Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão!

Todas as nossas vagas são abertas a pessoas de todos os perfis, incluindo pessoas com deficiência (PcD), pessoas negras, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+, 50+, entre outros grupos minorizados.

Caso você precise de algum recurso ou adaptação para participar do processo seletivo ou exercer suas atividades, por favor, informe no campo “Descrição das atividades”. Estamos comprometidos em oferecer um ambiente acessível e acolhedor para todos.

1. Realizar assistência médica respeitando as premissas do Código de Ética Médica.

2. Exercer atribuições conforme a política da CASSI.

3. Realizar consulta e atendimento médico, por meio de anamnese, exame físico, solicitação e análise de

exames complementares conforme estratégias, programas e diretrizes da CASSI.

4. Emitir diagnósticos e aplicar recursos de medicina terapêutica e preventiva aos participantes.

5. Efetuar e requisitar exames complementares de acordo com os protocolos estabelecidos e necessidade

6. Interpretar resultados de exames de imagem, biométricos, hematológicos, bioquímicos e outros,

comparando-os com os padrões normais com finalidade de emitir diagnóstico.

7. Indicar e prescrever medicamentos e terapias, visando à prevenção e tratamento de doenças assim como a

manutenção e promoção da saúde

8. Emitir atestados de saúde e aptidão física e mental, quando necessário.

9. Emitir atestado médico com finalidade de afastamento das atividades habituais dos participantes, quando

necessário.

10. Realizar registro dos pacientes examinados no prontuário eletrônico do participante (PEP), anotando a

anamnese, exame-físico, resultados de exames, hipótese diagnóstica, tratamento, orientações e evolução

da doença.

11. Ser, quando indicado pela CASSI, o responsável técnico em sua área de atribuição, perante órgãos

12. Realizar atendimento de urgência e emergência, sempre que necessário, no âmbito da CliniCASSI.

13. (+) Realizar interconsulta com outros profissionais de saúde, sempre que necessário.

14. Participar de programas e atividades de educação em saúde, articulado com equipe da APS, com vistas à

melhoria da saúde do participante.

15. Elaborar relatórios e laudos técnicos em sua área de especialidade, sempre que necessário.

16. Realizar a notificação compulsória de doenças, sempre que necessário.

17. Participar de discussão de casos clínicos, sempre que necessário.

18. Participar de campanhas educativas nos campos da saúde pública e da medicina preventiva.

19. Prestar informações do processo saúde-doença aos participantes e a seus familiares.

20. Realizar diagnóstico da comunidade Cassi e levantar indicadores de saúde para avaliação do impacto das

ações em saúde implementadas.

21. Orientar e zelar pela preservação e guarda dos equipamentos, aparelhos e instrumentais utilizados em sua

especialidade, observando a sua correta utilização.

22. Utilizar equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI) conforme preconizado pela ANVISA.

23. Orientar os colaboradores que o auxiliam na execução das tarefas típicas do cargo.

Na CASSI somos movidos pelo propósito que é o de “Cuidar do participante em todas as fases da sua vida”, ainda que façamos parte de uma equipe de atividade meio ou fim, nosso propósito é único e sempre voltado ao participante da CASSI.

Precisamos de pessoas que estejam dispostas a aprender e multiplicar conhecimento, avaliar e trocar ideias sobre o processo com a ótica de que podemos estar em constantes mudanças e melhorias.

Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão!

Todas as nossas vagas são abertas a pessoas de todos os perfis, incluindo pessoas com deficiência (PcD), pessoas negras, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+, 50+, entre outros grupos minorizados.

16. Realizar a notificação compulsória de doenças, sempre que necessário.

17. Participar de discussão de casos clínicos, sempre que necessário.

18. Participar de campanhas educativas nos campos da saúde pública e da medicina preventiva.

19. Prestar informações do processo saúde-doença aos participantes e a seus familiares.

As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta.

AS PESSOAS SEGURAS SÃO MAIS FELIZES! Esse pensamento é a essência que rege a CAPEMISA nesses mais de 60 anos de história. Aqui Segurança e satisfação são sinônimos e só são plenos quando são compartilhados. Por isso, estamos sempre pensando em maneiras de proteger e valorizar nossa equipe. E o esforço se traduziu em resultados, de produtividade e na conquista do selo GreatPlaceToWork . Se você quer estagiar em uma empresa com um time de alto nível e um ambiente colaborativo venha fazer parte da nossa equipe. Aqui na CAPEMISA , você será mais que um estagiário, fará parte de um super programa de estágio pensado para o seu desenvolvimento com oportunidade de colaborar, inovar, aprender e transformar. A nossa prata da casa vale ouro.

Aqui estão alguns dos benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Super bolsa auxílio;
  • Um time que valoriza a prata da casa, ótimo ambiente para trabalhar e oportunidade para desenvolver a sua carreira através de trilha de desenvolvimento estruturada;

  • Horário de trabalho flexível: aqui você define com a sua liderança o melhor horário para começar a trabalhar.

  • ♀️ E para a vida fitness: GymPass, para você e seus dependentes.

title: Head Of Marketing
description:
At Suntory Global Spirits, we craft spirits of the highest quality and deliver brilliant experiences to people around the world. Suntory Global Spirits has evolved into the world's third largest leading premium spirits company ... where each employee is treated like family and trusted with legacy. With our greatest assets - our premium spirits and our people - we're driving growth through impactful marketing, innovation and an entrepreneurial spirit. Suntory Global Spirits is a place where you can come Unleash your Spirit by making an impact each and every day.

What makes this a great opportunity?

Responsible for the development and implementation of compelling and focused brand strategies delivering exceptional in-market brand and portfolio performance while strengthening brand equity. The Head of Marketing is responsible for ensuring that the Brand DNA of global and local brands is nurtured and strengthened through brand experiences, communication platforms and innovations that place the rich understanding of culture and consumers at the heart of our work. Balancing this with strong commercial acumen, gained from a Gemba mindset, and an obsession for excellence in execution, the Head of Marketing needs to work with external partners (agencies, customers, distilleries, amongst others), International functions and Brand Houses to ensure that we delight consumers at every touch point through integrated marketing plans.

Role Responsibilities
  • Build marketing capability in Brazil and mentor the SGS global marketing community. Develop succession plans for key marketing roles.
  • Inspire and align global marketing teams behind a culturally relevant growth strategy for the portfolio.
  • Drive “One Suntory Way of Marketing” through capability building: knowledge, systems, leadership, culture, process, structure, and measurement.
  • Deliver financial targets, strategic objectives, and long-term brand equity goals for Brazil.
  • Embed consumer, cultural, competitor, category, and customer insights into brand strategy and execution.
  • Understand customer perceptions and consumer behavior to uncover growth opportunities beyond surface-level data.
  • Ensure global brand strategies are adaptable across cultural and category differences.
  • Link brand strategies and budget decisions to short- and long-term P&L delivery with strong financial acumen.
  • Oversee BI, vendor contracts, and payment management.
  • Collaborate with sales on L2L strategy, POS activities, and brand activation events.
  • Partner with the Master Blender/Distiller to define local brands' House Style and evolve liquid experiences.
  • Protect brand equity by embedding timeless DNA into strategies while balancing short-term business needs.
  • Develop distinctive brand ID and design codes for packaging and communications to enhance saliency and consumer memory.
  • Implement global brand foundations and align portfolio strategy with international regions, Edrington, and Brand Houses.
  • Accelerate global premium brands while nurturing local jewels like Larios and DYC.
  • Align BH 12-Year strategies and 3-Year Strat Plan with brand DNA and market opportunities.
  • Create compelling positioning for local brands tied to modern culture and global communication platforms.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to finalize Brand’s 3-Year Growth Plans and innovation strategy, strengthening DNA and meeting commercial objectives.
  • Lead PBMC performance diagnoses and corrective actions.
  • Deploy impactful, integrated brand experiences focused on “fewer, bigger” initiatives for consumer engagement and trade excitement.
  • Achieve execution excellence, starting with perfect serve experiences and amplified consumer programs.
  • Foster a learning culture by tracking programs and performance against KPIs.
  • Ensure marketing plans support financial targets, including budget adherence and activity phasing for growth.
  • Embed agility in BH strategy execution to address dynamic market and competitor shifts.
  • Provide direction to the Commercial Marketing team (25) for flawless global and local brand execution
Qualifications
  • -University degree- BS/BA or equivalent
  • 15+ years’ consumer marketing experience. Global CPG, luxury brands or spirits experience preferred
  • Business degree (MBA preferred).
  • Ideally global or cross market brand experience.
  • Demonstrable achievements in growing brands and managing complex brand portfolios within a matrixed organization requiring strong cross functional leadership.
  • Strong commercial experience with P&L responsibility and demonstrated track record of engaging effectively with commercial partners to drive alignment and performance.
  • Has managed and developed teams successfully and, ideally, has experience of leading diverse, global teams and talent.
  • Proven leadership in driving alignment to strategic brand vision within a global matrix organization. Strong communicator and collaborative leader able to engage internal and external stakeholders. Ability to influence and build productive relationships with peers on the Leadership Team and across the company
  • Strategic thinker with solid experience in consumer insights, brand strategy and business analytics. Ability to simplify complex issues and drive focus on a focused number of key issues and opportunities for the brand.
  • Experience in leading and managing the creative brand building and innovation process and fostering productive relationships with agencies, creative teams and cross functional partners. Proven record in partnering with Sales and Commercial leaders to align marketing strategy to commercial goals
  • A track record in bringing new thinking and ideas to a business/brand in order to accelerate growth.
  • Strong Commercial and Financial Acumen with a focus on driving sustainable profitable growth and being astute in all areas of the commercial P&L (product and channel mix, investment, logistics, COGS, pricing) and budget management.
  • Proven ability to build effective teams, coach and develop direct reports in order to strengthen organizational capability.
  • A strong curiosity for and, ideally experience of, different cultures and markets across the world.

While relocation, immigration, and/or tax compliance support are not guaranteed, we may offer assistance to successful candidates depending on factors such as role requirements in accordance with company guidelines.
