  • Responsible for assisting in development, implementation, and action plans to correct potential or identified risk problem areas.
  • Actively participate or delegate responsibility in calculating the number of direct nursing care personnel on duty each shift (PPD). Report such information to the Administrator to ensure that accurate staffing information is posted, and budgetary measures are met.
  • Agree not to disclose assigned user ID code and password for accessing resident/facility information and promptly report suspected or known violations of such disclosure to the Administrator.
  • Agree not to disclose resident’s protected health information and promptly report suspected or known violations of such disclosure to the Administrator.
  • Report any known or suspected unauthorized attempt to access facility’s information system.
Committee Functions
  • Serve on, participate in, and attend various committees of the facility as appointed by the Administrator.
  • Evaluate and implement recommendations from established committees as they may pertain to nursing services.
  • Follow the Pharmaceutical Services written policies and procedures for the administration, storage, and control of medications and supplies.
  • Schedule, attend, and participate in developing the agenda for Care Plan Committee meetings, as necessary.
  • Participate in regularly scheduled reviews of the Discharge Plans and make such plans available to the Care Plan Committee, as necessary.
Personnel Functions
  • Review the staffing needs of the nursing service department with the Administrator when necessary to meet the daily nursing needs of the residents.
  • Assist the Administrator and/or the HR Director in the recruitment and selection of nursing service personnel.
  • Validate that all nursing assistants are enrolled in or have graduated from an approved training program and that all CAN certifications are current and active.
  • Responsible for or delegate to appropriate staff members to schedule a sufficient number of licensed practical and/or registered nurses for each tour of duty to ascertain that quality care is maintained.
  • Responsible for or assign delegate to appropriate staff member to schedule a sufficient number of certified nursing assistants for each tour of duty to ascertain that routine nursing care is provided to meet the daily nursing care needs or each resident.
  • Make certain that all nurse aide trainees are under the direct supervision or a licensed nurse.
  • Develop work assignments and schedule duty hours, and/or assist nursing supervisory staff in completing and performing such tasks.
  • Delegate to nursing service supervisory personnel the administrative authority, responsibility, and accountability necessary to perform their assigned duties.
  • Make daily rounds of the nursing service department to determine that nursing service personnel are performing their work assignments in accordance with acceptable nursing standards.
  • Monitor absenteeism to ensure that an adequate number of nursing care personnel are always on duty.
  • Follow written procedures for validating that professional nursing personnel, including private duty nurses, have valid and current licenses as required by this State.
  • Review complaints and grievances made or filed by department personnel and complete the process for addressing as per handbook policy.
  • Provide complaint/grievance reports to the Administrator and SSD as required or as may be necessary.
  • Responsible that departmental disciplinary action is administered fairly and without discrimination of any kind.
  • Act as the Infection Control Coordinator in establishing a TB management program for employees.
  • Report occupational exposures to blood, body fluids, infectious materials, and hazardous chemicals in accordance with the facility’s policies and procedures governing accidents and incidents.
  • Confirm that all CNA’s credentials are verified through the State Nurse Aide Registry.
  • Responsible for appropriate reporting of adverse personnel actions relative to CNA’s employment criteria to the State Nurse Aide Registry.
  • Terminate employment of personnel when necessary, documenting and coordinating such actions with the HR Director and/or Administrator.
  • Report known or suspected incidents of fraud to the Administrator.
  • Monitor that departmental computer workstations left unattended are properly logged off or the password protected automatic screensaver activates within established facility policy guidelines.
Nursing Care Functions
  • Participate in the interviewing and selection of residents for admission to the facility, including PAS A RR screenings.
  • Provide the Administrator with information relative to the nursing needs of the resident and the nursing service department’s ability to meet those needs.
  • Inform nursing service personnel of new admissions, their expected time of arrival, room assignment, etc.
  • Ensure that rooms are ready for new admissions.
  • Greet newly admitted residents upon admission. Escort to room, as necessary.
  • Encourage attending physicians to record and sign progress notes, physicians’ orders, etc., on a timely basis and in accordance with current regulations.
  • Responsible to make certain that direct nursing care be provided by a licensed nurse, a CNA, and/or a nurse aide trainee qualified to perform the procedure.
  • Routinely audit random nurses’ notes to ensure that they are informative and descriptive of the nursing care being provided, that they respect the resident’s response to the care, and that such care is provided in accordance with the resident’s wishes.
  • Monitor medication passes and treatment schedules to make certain that medications are being administered as ordered and that treatments are provided as scheduled.
  • Delegate responsibility to supervisory nursing staff that residents who are unable to call for help are checked frequently.
  • Conduct clinical meetings with IDT to review clinical documentation.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain an effective orientation program that orients the new employee to the department, its policies and procedures, and to his/her job position and duties.
  • Provide leadership training that includes the administrative and supervisory principles essential for Nurse Supervisors/Charge Nurses.
  • Encourage the nursing supervisory staff to attend and participate in outside training programs. Schedule times as appropriate.
  • Assist the Administrator in developing and revising the nursing assistant training curriculum if used by the facility. Submit to state agency for approval as required.
  • Assist the In-service Director/Educator and/or are responsible for developing annual facility in-service training programs (e.G., OSHA, TB, HIPAA, Abuse Prevention, Safety, infection Control, etc.).
  • Develop advance directive in-service training programs for the staff and community.
  • Develop, implement, and conduct in-service training programs that relate to the nursing service department.
  • Assist the In-service Director/Educator and/or are responsible for the development or in-service training programs for the nursing staff. Make certain that these programs meet the continuing education requirements that allow licensed personnel (e.G., RNs, LPNs, CNAs, etc.) to keep their licenses on an active status.
  • Attend and participate in continuing educational programs designed to keep you abreast of changes in your profession, as well as to maintain your license on a current status.
  • Verify that the department’s policy and procedure manuals identify safety precautions and equipment to use when performing tasks that could result in bodily injury.
  • Act as the Infection Control Coordinator in identifying, evaluating, and classifying routine and job‑related functions to ensure that tasks in which potential exposure to blood/body fluids are properly identified and recorded.
  • Determine that all personnel performing tasks that involve potential exposure to blood/body fluids participate in appropriate in‑service training programs prior to performing such tasks.
  • Confirm that adequate supplies of personal protective equipment are on hand and are readily available to personnel who perform procedures that involve exposure to blood or body fluids.
  • Monitor nursing service personnel to confirm that they are following established safety regulations in the use of equipment and supplies.
  • Supervise that nursing service work areas (i.E., nurses’ stations, medication rooms, etc.) are maintained in a clean and sanitary manner. Determine through rounds and supervision that all resident care rooms, treatment areas, etc., are maintained in a clean, safe, and sanitary manner.
  • Monitor that nursing service personnel participate in and conduct all fire safety and disaster preparedness drills in a safe and professional manner.
  • Assist the Infection Control Committee in the development, implementation, and revising of written aseptic and isolation techniques.
  • Develop, implement and maintain a program for monitoring communicable and/or infectious diseases, including TB, among the residents and personnel.
  • Through training and monitoring, make certain that nursing service personnel follow established infection control procedures when isolation precautions (or any universal precautions) become necessary.
  • Maintain a procedure for reporting hazardous conditions or equipment.
  • Monitor to make certain that personnel wear and/or use safety equipment and supplies (e.G., gait belt, mechanical lifts, etc.) when lifting or moving residents.
  • Report missing/illegible labels and MSDSs to the safety officer or other designated person.
Equipment and Supply Functions
  • Recommend to the Administrator the equipment and supply needs of the department.
  • Through delegation of appropriate staff, make certain that a stock level of medications, medical supplies, equipment, etc., is maintained on premises at all times to adequately meet the needs of the resident.
  • Assist the Maintenance Director in developing a preventive maintenance program for maintaining the nursing service department’s equipment and supplies in a safe and operable manner.
  • Implement procedures for the safe operation of all nursing service equipment.
  • Through delegation of appropriate staff, confirm that only trained and authorized personnel operate the department’s equipment.
  • Make certain that all personnel operate nursing service equipment in a safe manner.
  • Develop and implement procedures that ensure nursing service supplies are used in an efficient manner to avoid waste.
  • Responsible to make certain personal protective equipment used in the handling of infectious materials are available and easily accessible to nursing service personnel.
Care Plan and Assessment Functions
  • Assist in the development of preliminary and comprehensive assessments of the nursing needs of each resident, as necessary.
  • Encourage the resident and his/her family to participate in the development and review of the resident’s plan of care, as necessary.
  • Assist the MDS Coordinator in the scheduling of care plans and assessments to be presented and discussed at each committee meeting if needed.
  • Through delegation of appropriate staff, make certain that all personnel involved in providing care to the resident are aware of the resident’s care plan. Ensure that nursing personnel refer to the resident’s care plan prior to administering daily care to the resident.
  • Audit and review nurses’ notes to determine if the care plan is being followed. Ensure that the 24‑Hour Reporting system is maintained and followed.
  • Responsible to monitor that resident assessment information is transmitted on a timely basis.
  • Review and revise care plans and assessments, as necessary.
  • Develop and maintain a good rapport with all services involved with the care plan to make certain that a team effort is achieved in developing a comprehensive plan of care.
  • Develop clinical staff to required level to determine that medical and nursing care is administered in accordance with the resident’s wishes, including the implementation of advance directives.
  • Keep abreast of economic conditions/situations and recommend to the Administrator adjustments in nursing services that secure the continued ability to provide quality care.
  • Report suspected or known incidence of fraud relative to false billings, cost reports, kickbacks, etc.
  • Monitor nursing care to make certain that all residents are treated fairly, kindly, with dignity, and respect.
  • Monitor clinical staff to make certain that all nursing care is provided in privacy and that nursing service personnel knock before entering the resident’s room.
  • Monitor that all nursing service personnel are knowledgeable of the residents, responsibilities and rights including the right to refuse treatment.
  • Review complaints and grievances made by the resident and make a written/oral report to the Administrator indicating what action(s) were taken to resolve the complaint or grievance. Follow facility’s established procedures. Maintain a written record of the resident’s complaints and/or grievances that indicates the action taken to resolve the complaint and the current status of the complaint.
  • Coordinate with Social Services that appropriate notices are given to residents before their room or roommate is changed.
  • Monitor that nursing staff personnel honor the resident’s refusal of treatment request. Validate that such requests are in accordance with the facility’s policies governing advance directives.
  • Ensure that the facility’s policies and procedures governing advance directives are reviewed with the resident and/or representative.
  • Performs Additional duties as assigned.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Must have, as a minimum, five (5) years of experience as a supervisor in a hospital, nursing care facility, or other related health care facility.
  • Must possess a current, unencumbered, active license to practice as a Registered Nurse in this state.
  • Must demonstrate the knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to the age-related needs of the residents served.
  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand the English language.
  • Leadership skills and ability and willingness to work harmoniously with and supervise other personnel.
  • Must be a supportive team member, contribute to and be an example of teamwork and team concept.
  • The ability to make independent decisions when circumstances warrant such action.
  • The ability to deal tactfully with personnel, residents, family members, visitors, government agencies/personnel, and the general public.
  • Must be knowledgeable of nursing and medical practices and procedures, as well as laws, regulations, and guidelines that pertain to nursing care facilities.
  • Must possess the ability to plan, organize, develop, implement, and interpret the programs, goals, objectives, policies and procedures, etc., that are necessary for providing quality care.
  • Must have patience, tact, a cheerful disposition, enthusiasm, and the willingness to handle challenging residents.
  • Must be able to relate information concerning a resident’s condition.
  • Must not pose a direct threat to the health or safety of other individuals in the workplace.
  • Intermediate to advanced skill level in Microsoft Office or similar software applications.
  • Ability to use office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax/scan machines
  • Ability to multi-task, work successfully under pressure, effectively prioritize, manage time and workload.
  • Willingness and ability to seek out new methods and principles and be willing to incorporate them into existing activity services.
  • Possession of excellent communication skills and ability to convey information concerning a resident’s condition.
  • The ability to cope with the mental and emotional stress of the position.
  • Must have a good driving record, valid, driver’s license, vehicle insurance and a reliable vehicle.
WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL EFFORT
  • While performing the duties of this job the employee is regularly required to stand;
    walk;
    talk, listen, reach with hands and arms;
    climb, balance;
    and stoop, kneel, crouch, and crawl.
  • This position requires frequent manual dexterity in combination with eye/hand coordination such as keyboarding and handling of equipment.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Must meet the general health requirements set forth by the policies of this facility.
  • Must be able to push, pull, move, and/or lift a minimum of 25 pounds to a minimum height of 5 feet and be able to push, pull, move, and/or carry such weight a minimum distance of 50 feet.
  • May be necessary to assist in the evacuation of residents during emergency situations.
  • Tasks assigned to this position may involve potential and/or direct exposure to blood, body fluids, infectious diseases, air contaminants and hazardous chemicals.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate with occasional louder moments.

Acreditamos na diversidade de ideias e de culturas como um caminho certo para impulsionar o pensamento criativo e estimular um ambiente favorável ao olhar inovador. Com um time de alta performance e especialistas nas mais diversas áreas do Direito, buscamos profissionais que aliem um profundo conhecimento dos negócios de nossos clientes a um olhar diferenciado para oferecer soluções singulares do mais alto nível de qualidade, sofisticação e rigor.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Subsídio comprade equipamentos (para vagas híbridas ou 100% home office).
Sobre o Lefosse

Com experiência e histórico em casos emblemáticos dos mais variados segmentos, fomos eleitos pelo The Legal 500 como o melhor escritório do ano no Brasil, o mais alto reconhecimento do mercado jurídico.

Somos um escritório com pensamento inovador e crescimento acelerado. Atuamos de forma multidisciplinar em mais de 20 práticas e quadruplicamos nosso quadro societário nos últimos anos, reforçando nosso time jurídico. Hoje, o Lefosse é uma plataforma completa para impulsionar negócios.

Acreditamos na pluralidade e na democratização da justiça. Por isso, implementamos o VOZES, nosso programa de Diversidade, Equidade e Pertencimento, para fomentar uma cultura inclusiva e gerar oportunidades para todas as pessoas. Também prestamos serviço jurídico gratuito para entidades sem fins lucrativos por meio do programa Lefosse Pro Bono.

Aqui no Lefosse nosso modelo é híbrido, com ajuda de custo para o trabalho remoto e política de home office estabelecida. Nós incentivamos a autonomia, a flexibilidade e o cultura digital, sem perder de vista a excelência, a colaboração e o foco no cliente.

Cada um de nossos profissionais tem papel fundamental no fortalecimento diário de quem somos e do que valorizamos e nossa cultura é fundamentada em valores e princípios que norteiam todas as nossas decisões.

EMPREENDEDORISMO, EXCELÊNCIA, PARCERIA e HUMANO : é assim que a gente é. Faça parte do nosso time!

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company - Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company - Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company - Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours.

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours.

This is not your usual job post.

Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours.

Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one!

So let's start.

Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services.

Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B.

I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground.

We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that - if you are a runner and marketeer - probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban.

You’ll be working on a newsletter and… an email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà : now you nailed it!

Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world!

We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more… right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends.

Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, BUT someone with a data / automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously.

And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you’ll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way.

You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts.

That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don’t throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works.

You’ll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role.

I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that “makes sense” to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive.

I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners!

Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion).

Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)).

My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way.

We’re just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work.

The money should not be the main motivation for you - running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast-moving, and positive company should.

The Contract Details Are As Follows USD 1,400 a month 25 hrs a week Managed via Upwork. Oh, and hey… if you’re considering this role as an add-on to an already existing full-time job, then hold your horses.

I don’t believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn’t align with our company values.

We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.

The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself.

But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle.

That’s it, I think.

We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously.

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more…

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode: growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business;
growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations;
growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends.

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Hi...

My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours.

This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start.

Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban.

You’ll be working on a newsletter and…

  • an email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors.

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time, not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world. We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more…right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground.

We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You'll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role.

I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners!

Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)). My guess is that ifyou are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We're just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You - Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast‑moving, And Positive Company Should.

Contract Details
  • USD 1,400 a month
  • 25 hrs a week
  • Managed via Upwork

Oh, and hey... if you're considering this role as an add-on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow... the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle. That's it, I think.

I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version).

Thanks for reading this far,

Lena

title: Gerente De Pesquisa Clinica
description:
O/a Gerente Local/Regional de Qualidade, Conformidade e Gestão de Fornecedores do CDO (Clinical Development Operations) fornece liderança estratégica, expertise funcional e supervisão operacional no nível da Unidade Regional/Operativa (R/OPU). Essa função é responsável por impulsionar a qualidade e a conformidade no planejamento, preparação e condução (incluindo monitoramento) de programas clínicos em toda a área de Operações de Desenvolvimento Clínico (CDO).

Além disso, o cargo supervisiona e coordena parcerias estratégicas com Organizações de Pesquisa Clínica (CRO) e a gestão de fornecedores locais, garantindo entrega operacional, qualidade, supervisão contratual e financeira em alinhamento com padrões globais, requisitos regulatórios e objetivos organizacionais.

O/a gerente representa a R/OPU nas redes globais funcionais de qualidade e gestão de fornecedores, protegendo a integridade dos dados, a segurança do paciente e a prontidão para inspeções, enquanto promove melhoria contínua e excelência no desenvolvimento clínico.

Papéis e Responsabilidades:
  • Liderança em Qualidade e Compliance
    • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de qualidade e planos de prontidão para inspeções regulatórias (Inspection Readiness).
    • Conduzir revisões de qualidade e atuar como ponto focal para desvios e não conformidades.
    • Liderar decisões estratégicas e resolver questões complexas envolvendo múltiplas áreas.
    • Orientar equipes na elaboração de planos de Ação Corretiva e Preventiva (CAPA).
    • Ministrar treinamentos e disseminar lições aprendidas relacionadas a qualidade e compliance.
    • Identificar riscos e conduzir estratégias de mitigação.
    • Representar a R/OPU em fóruns globais e locais de qualidade e compliance.
  • Gestão de Fornecedores e Coordenação Operacional
    • Gerenciar parceiros estratégicos (CROs) e fornecedores locais.
    • Implementar estratégias de terceirização alinhadas ao modelo operacional global.
    • Conduzir reuniões de governança e avaliar performance dos fornecedores.
    • Gerenciar resolução de problemas e transições de equipe junto às CROs.
    • Apoiar auditorias internas e inspeções regulatórias.
    • Definir escopo de serviços e garantir alocação adequada de recursos para estudos clínicos.
  • Colaboração com Stakeholders e Gestão de Relacionamentos
    • Estabelecer parcerias sólidas com áreas internas (Qualidade, Medicina, Jurídico, Regulatório etc.) e stakeholders externos (CROs, autoridades regulatórias, auditores, comitês de ética).
    • Representar a R/OPU em iniciativas globais de qualidade e compliance.
  • Melhoria Contínua, Treinamento e Gestão do Conhecimento
    • Promover cultura de melhoria contínua e compartilhamento de melhores práticas.
    • Liderar iniciativas de otimização de processos e apoiar equipes nas atividades operacionais.
    • Facilitar transferência de conhecimento e oportunidades de mentoria.
  • Conformidade Regulatória e Organizacional
    • Assegurar aderência às regulamentações nacionais e internacionais, POPs, práticas corporativas e padrões éticos.
    • Manter foco em qualidade, inovação e geração de valor para o paciente.
E o que você precisa para cumprir a sua missão?
  • Graduação na área da saúde ou área equivalente.
  • Experiência relevante em operações clínicas na indústria farmacêutica ou em CRO.
  • Conhecimento prático de ICH-GCP e regulamentações aplicáveis.
  • Experiência sólida em operações de estudos clínicos, liderança em compliance e gestão de fornecedores.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado de ICH-GCP, processos regulatórios, monitoramento de centros e gestão da qualidade baseada em risco.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, habilidades de comunicação, gestão de projetos e liderança.
  • Influencia a execução do modelo operacional de CRO, aprimorando a experiência de pacientes e centros.
  • Garante a condução eficiente e ética dos programas clínicos, reduz riscos regulatórios e apoia decisões estratégicas.
  • Experiência prévia em estudos clínicos e participação em inspeções regulatórias são desejáveis.

title: F&I Specialist
description: About Us: Chery is a leading Chinese automotive company with a diverse portfolio that includes the R&D, production, and sales of passenger cars, commercial vehicles, mini cars, specialty vehicles, and powertrain systems. title: Gerente De Pesquisa Clinica
description:
A sua missão será:

O/a Gerente Local/Regional de Qualidade, Conformidade e Gestão de Fornecedores do CDO (Clinical Development Operations) fornece liderança estratégica, expertise funcional e supervisão operacional no nível da Unidade Regional/Operativa (R/OPU). Essa função é responsável por impulsionar a qualidade e a conformidade no planejamento, preparação e condução (incluindo monitoramento) de programas clínicos em toda a área de Operações de Desenvolvimento Clínico (CDO).

Além disso, o cargo supervisiona e coordena parcerias estratégicas com Organizações de Pesquisa Clínica (CRO) e a gestão de fornecedores locais, garantindo entrega operacional, qualidade, supervisão contratual e financeira em alinhamento com padrões globais, requisitos regulatórios e objetivos organizacionais.

O/a gerente representa a R/OPU nas redes globais funcionais de qualidade e gestão de fornecedores, protegendo a integridade dos dados, a segurança do paciente e a prontidão para inspeções, enquanto promove melhoria contínua e excelência no desenvolvimento clínico.

Papéis e Responsabilidades:Principais ResponsabilidadesLiderança em Qualidade e Compliance
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de qualidade e planos de prontidão para inspeções regulatórias (Inspection Readiness).
  • Conduzir revisões de qualidade e atuar como ponto focal para desvios e não conformidades.
  • Liderar decisões estratégicas e resolver questões complexas envolvendo múltiplas áreas.
  • Orientar equipes na elaboração de planos de Ação Corretiva e Preventiva (CAPA).
  • Ministrar treinamentos e disseminar lições aprendidas relacionadas a qualidade e compliance.
  • Identificar riscos e conduzir estratégias de mitigação.
  • Representar a R/OPU em fóruns globais e locais de qualidade e compliance.
Gestão de Fornecedores e Coordenação Operacional
  • Gerenciar parceiros estratégicos (CROs) e fornecedores locais.
  • Implementar estratégias de terceirização alinhadas ao modelo operacional global.
  • Conduzir reuniões de governança e avaliar performance dos fornecedores.
  • Gerenciar resolução de problemas e transições de equipe junto às CROs.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e inspeções regulatórias.
  • Definir escopo de serviços e garantir alocação adequada de recursos para estudos clínicos.
Colaboração com Stakeholders e Gestão de Relacionamentos
  • Estabelecer parcerias sólidas com áreas internas (Qualidade, Medicina, Jurídico, Regulatório etc.) e stakeholders externos (CROs, autoridades regulatórias, auditores, comitês de ética).
  • Representar a R/OPU em iniciativas globais de qualidade e compliance.
Melhoria Contínua, Treinamento e Gestão do Conhecimento
  • Promover cultura de melhoria contínua e compartilhamento de melhores práticas.
  • Liderar iniciativas de otimização de processos e apoiar equipes nas atividades operacionais.
  • Facilitar transferência de conhecimento e oportunidades de mentoria.
Conformidade Regulatória e Organizacional
  • Assegurar aderência às regulamentações nacionais e internacionais, POPs, práticas corporativas e padrões éticos.
  • Manter foco em qualidade, inovação e geração de valor para o paciente.

E o que você precisa para cumprir a sua missão?

Requeridos:
  • Graduação na área da saúde ou área equivalente.
  • Experiência relevante em operações clínicas na indústria farmacêutica ou em CRO.
  • Conhecimento prático de ICH-GCP e regulamentações aplicáveis.
  • Experiência sólida em operações de estudos clínicos, liderança em compliance e gestão de fornecedores.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado de ICH-GCP, processos regulatórios, monitoramento de centros e gestão da qualidade baseada em risco.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, habilidades de comunicação, gestão de projetos e liderança.
  • Influencia a execução do modelo operacional de CRO, aprimorando a experiência de pacientes e centros.
  • Garante a condução eficiente e ética dos programas clínicos, reduz riscos regulatórios e apoia decisões estratégicas.
Desejáveis:
  • Experiência prévia em estudos clínicos e participação em inspeções regulatórias são desejáveis.

Liderar um time criativo de 4 pessoas, garantindo entregas consistentes e inovadoras.

Desenvolver e evoluir a identidade visual da marca, assegurando consistência em todos os canais.

Criar key visuals (KVs), moodboards e campanhas temáticas para lançamentos, datas sazonais e calendário promocional.

Planejar, dirigir e acompanhar shootings fotográficos (campanhas e still de produtos), assegurando excelência técnica e estética.

Gerenciar demandas criativas, organizando e priorizando tarefas conforme estratégia de marketing e vendas.

Trabalhar em dupla com a cadeira de marketing e comunicação, garantindo cobertura de todas as pautas comerciais e institucionais.

Produzir e acompanhar materiais online e offline (redes sociais, e-commerce, PDV, catálogos, embalagens).

Pesquisar tendências e referências visuais para o universo baby/puericultura .

Garantir consistência visual e alinhamento com o posicionamento da marca.

Requisitos:

Graduação em Design Gráfico, Comunicação Visual, Publicidade ou áreas relacionadas.

Importante ter atuado em direção de arte, especialmente em marcas de consumo e produtos infantis.

Portfólio robusto que evidencie criatividade, identidade visual forte e direção de arte para campanhas.

Diferenciais que amamos:

Vivência ou envolvimento direto com o universo baby/puericultura.

Habilidade para liderar com empatia, pensando nas necessidades do time e do público.

Se você tem uma forte conexão com o universo da primeira infância, e está pronto (a) para liderar com criatividade, gestão e impacto, queremos muito te conhecer!

Localização: Barra Funda, São Paulo – SP

Contratação: PJ

Criando conexões com propósito: esse é o Nosso Jeito

No Grupo Moas, acreditamos no poder das conexões. Somos um time apaixonado por qualidade, movido por inovação e guiado por valores sólidos como cuidado, transparência, respeito e colaboração. Desde 2003, crescemos com o olhar atento de quem entende que bem-estar se constrói com sensibilidade e funcionalidade.

Na jornada das famílias, desenvolvemos produtos de puericultura, cuidados com a pele e momentos especiais com os pequenos — sempre com segurança, afeto e responsabilidade.

Já no universo da casa, inspiramos pessoas a criarem ambientes com alma, unindo curadoria, design contemporâneo e acessibilidade.

Conecte-se ao nosso propósito

Hoje, as marcas do Grupo Moas somam mais de 1 milhão de seguidores nas redes sociais e encantam e impactam mais de 10 milhões de pessoas todos os meses. Um alcance que reflete a força da nossa essência: criar conexões reais entre pessoas, lares e histórias.

Se você compartilha dessa essência e quer crescer junto com um grupo que valoriza o desenvolvimento, o bem-estar e a criatividade coletiva, o Grupo Moas é o seu lugar.

title: Principal Ai Engineer - Ai In Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

  • Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
  • Automated coding and billing optimization
  • Intelligent claim follow‑up to reduce denials
  • Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Very hands‑on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!

1. Build and Refine AI Products
  • Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
  • Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
  • Use AI‑assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions
2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
  • Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
  • Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy
3. Own the Development Lifecycle
  • Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
  • Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards
4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
  • Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
  • Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
  • In the near future, contribute to fine‑tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base
REQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
  • Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
  • Hands‑on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
  • Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
  • Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
  • Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)
2. Mindset & Approach
  • Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, ever‑changing startup environment
  • Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
  • A self‑starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
  • Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing
3. Highly Valued Qualifications
  • Experience with AI‑assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
  • Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management
  • Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.
WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
  • Ground‑floor opportunity in a stealth‑mode company with massive market potential
  • Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
  • Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale
2. Professional Excellence
  • Work alongside world‑class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
  • Access to cutting‑edge LLM technologies solving complex, real‑world problems
  • Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
  • Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside
3. Work‑Life Integration
  • Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
  • Fast‑paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
  • Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
  • Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability
READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Hi... my name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let’s start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients.

Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground.

  • An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors.

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture, and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more…right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you’ll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don’t throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works.

You will also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do). You will be working directly with me in the role.

I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that “makes sense” to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)). My guess is that ifyou are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world. The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You – Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast‑moving, And Positive Company Should. The Contract Details Are As Follows: USD 1,400 a month, 25 hrs a week, Managed via Upwork. Oh, and hey… if you’re considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don’t believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn’t align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle. That’s it, I think.

I’ve probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version).

Thanks for reading this far, Lena. Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3‑4 days as we receive many applicants.

Seniority level

Entry level

Employment type

Part-time

Job function

Marketing and Sales

O(a) Diretor(a) de Arte irá desenvolver projetos gráficos, layouts e identidades visuais, seguindo o briefing elaborado em conjunto com a equipe de planejamento.

Também tem a tarefa de acompanhar a produção de arte final e avaliar se o resultado corresponde à proposta estipulada.

Responsabilidades do dia a dia:
  • Gerar ideias e conceitos claros juntamente com o redator;
  • Produzir esboços, storyboards e rascunhos para visualizar ideias;
  • Entender as iniciativas de marketing, o posicionamento estratégico e o público-alvo;
  • Cooperar com o restante da equipe criativa em diferentes tipos de mídia;
  • Conduzir o trabalho, do conceito à execução final, dentro dos prazos;
  • Gerenciar e delegar responsabilidades a outros designers e fornecer instruções;
  • Apresentar ideias concluídas aos clientes / membros da equipe;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre todas as tendências e manter as melhores práticas.
Requirements:
  • Experiência profissional comprovada como Diretor(a) de Arte;
  • Experiência prática com design de logotipos, tipografia, tratamento de cores, layouts para internet, produção de impressão, seleção de imagem e design de embalagens;
  • Proficiência emInDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator ou outras ferramentas de desenho visual e wireframing;
  • Habilidades comprovadas em design gráfico, com um forte portfólio;
  • Incorporação defeedback e capacidade de receber e dar orientação;
  • Espírito de equipe e excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação;
  • Formação ou treinamento relacionado.

title: Ppc Lead Amazon Marketing Agency
description:
PPC Lead Amazon Marketing Agency (Remote)

Full-Time Remote Competitive Salary PTO

About Us

The company is a full-service Amazon marketing agency that delivers profitable sales growth for consumer brands. We specialize in Amazon SEO PPC listing optimization and catalog management and we do it with systems strategy and speed. We’re looking for a highly experienced and strategic PPC Lead to take ownership of advertising performance across our client portfolio.

The Role

You will be responsible for developing the PPC strategy for each client ensuring that it aligns with the overall Account Growth Plan created by the Brand Manager. You will also monitor and coach PPC Specialists, take ownership of performance outcomes and ensure that ACoS, TACoS and monthly spend stay within the agreed goals. You will also be an integral part of client communication – attending monthly client calls with the Brand Manager, participating in weekly internal check‑ins and providing clear updates and notes on performance and next steps. This role is ideal for an experienced PPC expert who wants to both lead strategy, mentor others and remain hands‑on with key client accounts.

Responsibilities
  • Develop and implement PPC strategy for up to 15 client accounts in partnership with the Brand Manager
  • Directly manage high-priority / high-value client accounts end-to-end
  • Oversee and mentor up to two PPC Specialists who manage smaller and more stable client accounts
  • Ensure ACoS, TACoS and monthly spend are aligned with set client goals and account growth plans
  • Oversee daily work of PPC Specialists – coaching them on best practices and reviewing their work to ensure quality and alignment with strategy
  • Attend one-on-one weekly check-ins with the Brand Manager
  • Attend monthly client calls with the Brand Manager and provide insights and updates
  • Provide clear notes and updates to the Brand Manager for client check‑in calls
  • Be responsive and communicative on Slack – responding promptly to questions from both the Brand Manager and PPC Specialists
  • Stay current with Amazon PPC trends, new features and optimization opportunities
  • Proactively monitor account health and take ownership of any issues – whether directly managed or through oversight of PPC Specialists
Requirements
  • Minimum 4 years of Amazon PPC experience
  • 100% accountability and responsibility – treat client accounts with the diligence and care as if it was your own personal brand
  • Proficiency with Helium 10, DataDive, Jungle Scout or similar keyword tools
  • Strong analytical mindset and comfort working with performance data
  • Ability to manage multiple client accounts at once while maintaining performance standards
  • Experience managing large ad budgets
  • Proficiency with Google Sheets and Excel
  • Experience using automated ad platforms such as Trellis, AdLabs, Bidx, Perpetua, Quartile or other similar software
  • Excellent communication skills for working with both Brand Manager and PPC Specialists
  • Highly reliable and organized – able to manage multiple accounts and PPC Specialists while actively contributing to account performance
  • Fast and reliable internet connection
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken
What You’ll Get
  • Competitive pay
  • 20 days PTO (including public holidays)
  • 10 days sick leave (with doctor’s note)
  • 100% remote work
  • Room to grow into roles like Brand Manager or Agency Leadership
  • A collaborative and growth‑minded team environment

Apply today and be part of a company that’s scaling fast and doing things differently in the Amazon space. We’re not looking for average. We’re looking for exceptional.

Employment Type: Full Time

Vacancy: 1

title: Head Of Marketing
description:
At Suntory Global Spirits, we craft spirits of the highest quality and deliver brilliant experiences to people around the world. Suntory Global Spirits has evolved into the world's third largest leading premium spirits company ... where each employee is treated like family and trusted with legacy. With our greatest assets - our premium spirits and our people - we're driving growth through impactful marketing, innovation and an entrepreneurial spirit. Suntory Global Spirits is a place where you can come Unleash your Spirit by making an impact each and every day.

What makes this a great opportunity?

Responsible for the development and implementation of compelling and focused brand strategies delivering exceptional in-market brand and portfolio performance while strengthening brand equity. The Head of Marketing is responsible for ensuring that the Brand DNA of global and local brands is nurtured and strengthened through brand experiences, communication platforms and innovations that place the rich understanding of culture and consumers at the heart of our work. Balancing this with strong commercial acumen, gained from a Gemba mindset, and an obsession for excellence in execution, the Head of Marketing needs to work with external partners (agencies, customers, distilleries, amongst others), International functions and Brand Houses to ensure that we delight consumers at every touch point through integrated marketing plans.

Role Responsibilities
  • Build marketing capability in Brazil and mentor the SGS global marketing community. Develop succession plans for key marketing roles.
  • Inspire and align global marketing teams behind a culturally relevant growth strategy for the portfolio.
  • Drive “One Suntory Way of Marketing” through capability building : knowledge, systems, leadership, culture, process, structure, and measurement.
  • Deliver financial targets, strategic objectives, and long-term brand equity goals for Brazil.
  • Embed consumer, cultural, competitor, category, and customer insights into brand strategy and execution.
  • Understand customer perceptions and consumer behavior to uncover growth opportunities beyond surface-level data.
  • Ensure global brand strategies are adaptable across cultural and category differences.
  • Link brand strategies and budget decisions to short- and long-term P&L delivery with strong financial acumen.
  • Oversee BI, vendor contracts, and payment management.
  • Collaborate with sales on L2L strategy, POS activities, and brand activation events.
  • Partner with the Master Blender / Distiller to define local brands' House Style and evolve liquid experiences.
  • Protect brand equity by embedding timeless DNA into strategies while balancing short-term business needs.
  • Develop distinctive brand ID and design codes for packaging and communications to enhance saliency and consumer memory.
  • Implement global brand foundations and align portfolio strategy with international regions, Edrington, and Brand Houses.
  • Accelerate global premium brands while nurturing local jewels like Larios and DYC.
  • Align BH 12-Year strategies and 3-Year Strat Plan with brand DNA and market opportunities.
  • Create compelling positioning for local brands tied to modern culture and global communication platforms.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to finalize Brand’s 3-Year Growth Plans and innovation strategy, strengthening DNA and meeting commercial objectives.
  • Lead PBMC performance diagnoses and corrective actions.
  • Deploy impactful, integrated brand experiences focused on “fewer, bigger” initiatives for consumer engagement and trade excitement.
  • Achieve execution excellence, starting with perfect serve experiences and amplified consumer programs.
  • Foster a learning culture by tracking programs and performance against KPIs.
  • Ensure marketing plans support financial targets, including budget adherence and activity phasing for growth.
  • Embed agility in BH strategy execution to address dynamic market and competitor shifts.
  • Provide direction to the Commercial Marketing team (25) for flawless global and local brand execution
Qualifications
  • University degree- BS / BA or equivalent
  • 15+ years’ consumer marketing experience. Global CPG, luxury brands or spirits experience preferred
  • Business degree (MBA preferred).
  • Ideally global or cross market brand experience.
  • Demonstrable achievements in growing brands and managing complex brand portfolios within a matrixed organization requiring strong cross functional leadership.
  • Strong commercial experience with P&L responsibility and demonstrated track record of engaging effectively with commercial partners to drive alignment and performance.
  • Has managed and developed teams successfully and, ideally, has experience of leading diverse, global teams and talent.
  • Proven leadership in driving alignment to strategic brand vision within a global matrix organization. Strong communicator and collaborative leader able to engage internal and external stakeholders. Ability to influence and build productive relationships with peers on the Leadership Team and across the company
  • Strategic thinker with solid experience in consumer insights, brand strategy and business analytics. Ability to simplify complex issues and drive focus on a focused number of key issues and opportunities for the brand.
  • Experience in leading and managing the creative brand building and innovation process and fostering productive relationships with agencies, creative teams and cross functional partners. Proven record in partnering with Sales and Commercial leaders to align marketing strategy to commercial goals
  • A track record in bringing new thinking and ideas to a business / brand in order to accelerate growth.
  • Strong Commercial and Financial Acumen with a focus on driving sustainable profitable growth and being astute in all areas of the commercial P&L (product and channel mix, investment, logistics, COGS, pricing) and budget management.
  • Proven ability to build effective teams, coach and develop direct reports in order to strengthen organizational capability.
  • A strong curiosity for and, ideally experience of, different cultures and markets across the world.

While relocation, immigration, and / or tax compliance support are not guaranteed, we may offer assistance to successful candidates depending on factors such as role requirements in accordance with company guidelines.

At Suntory Global Spirits, people are our number one priority, and we believe our people grow together in diverse and inclusive environments where their unique insights, experiences and backgrounds are valued and respected. Suntory Global Spirits is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, military veteran status and all other characteristics, attributes or choices protected by law. All recruitment and hiring decisions are based on an applicant’s skills and experience.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours .

Hi, my name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours.

This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours.

We are looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground.

Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B.

You’ll be working on a newsletter and planning email flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter. You will also own our digital advertising efforts, planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. You’ll also create case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations.

We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future will work with many more.

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way.

The salary is USD 1,400 a month, 25 hours a week, managed via Upwork. The contract is part‑time. We do not expect you to work more than 25 hours per week, and we want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.

Salary is not the main motivation. We value running, bridging cultures, being part of a fun, fast‑moving, positive company, and we want to find someone who can execute and help the business grow.

Seniority Level

Entry level

Employment Type

Part‑time

Job Function

Marketing and Sales

Industries

Travel Arrangements

  • Definir e executar o plano estratégico de marketing da GoNext, alinhado ao crescimento da companhia.
  • Consolidar o posicionamento da marca como referência em governança, sucessão e estratégia para grupos empresariais familiares.
2. Geração de Demanda e Suporte Comercial
  • Estruturar funnels de aquisição (digitais e offline) orientados ao público decisor: acionistas, presidentes, diretores e famílias empresárias.
  • Conduzir campanhas que resultem em oportunidades qualificadas (MQLs / SQLs) para o time comercial.

  • Desenvolver narrativas institucionais que reforcem a credibilidade, o histórico de mais de 300 projetos e a metodologia proprietária.
  • Garantir consistência da marca em todos os canais, eventos e materiais.
4. Conteúdo de Alto Impacto (Thought Leadership)
  • Liderar a produção de conteúdos estratégicos (artigos, estudos, vídeos, podcasts, reports e cases).
  • Expandir a presença da marca com foco em autoridade, educação do mercado e diferenciação.
5. Digital, Dados e Inteligência de Mercado
  • Estruturar um marketing data-driven, com análise contínua de indicadores, CAC, ROI e performance de campanhas.
  • Mapear tendências de governança, mercado B2B e movimentos de concorrentes para orientar decisões.
6. Gestão de Canais, Mídias e Parceiros
  • Coordenar agências, assessoria de imprensa, performance e fornecedores.
  • Expandir presença digital em redes sociais, LinkedIn e plataformas estratégicas.
7. Lançamento de Produtos e Novas Soluções
  • Liderar lançamentos da vertical de tecnologia, educação executiva e serviços escaláveis.
  • Estruturar precificação, narrativa de valor e estratégia go-to-market.
Perfil DesejadoBuscamos um(a) líder com :
  • Experiência sólida em marketing B2B, preferencialmente em consultorias, serviços profissionais ou empresas de alta complexidade.
  • Forte domínio de estratégias digitais, posicionamento, geração de demanda e marketing de conteúdo.
  • Perfil analítico, inovador, com capacidade de execução ágil e visão de negócio.
  • Excelente comunicação executiva e habilidade de dialogar com níveis C-Level, conselhos e famílias empresárias.
Benefícios e Condições

Modelo : Tempo integral
